# Delta decisions

A short ADR-style sample whose H3 subsections fold into cards, so the golden locks fold-mode emission end to end.

## Decisions

This section intro stays in view; only the decisions below fold into cards.

### D1 - Adopt fold mode

Fold mode collapses each H3 subtree behind a summary, so a long decision log scans as a list of titles.

> [!NOTE]
> A callout inside a folded card, proving nested blocks ride along.

### D2 - Keep the markdown flat

The doc stays plain CommonMark; only the site folds it.

#### A finer point

An H4 under a folded H3 stays inside the card, since it is deeper than the fold level.
